verdict_text:
YES

The regexes match exactly the 64 projection matrices and the 48 buffers (via `fullmatch`, so no over-broad `.*weight` capture), buffers are dropped, everything else is upcast to float32, names are untouched, all four required checks are asserted before writing, and the 256 MiB shard limit is passed to the writer. The only thing I cannot verify from reading is the shard/index layout itself, which lives in the unshown `_ckpt.save_sharded_safetensors`.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
